mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION (NOTI_ID, USER_ID, TYPE, TITLE, BODY, URL, DEDUPE_KEY) VALUES (nextval('SEQ_NOTIFICATION'), #{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{url}, #{dedupeKey}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, DEDUPE_KEY) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT NOTI_ID AS notiId, USER_ID AS userId, TYPE AS type, TITLE AS title, BODY AS body, URL AS url, (IS_READ = 'Y') AS read, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY NOTI_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOTI_ID = #{notiId}
UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOTI_ID = #{notiId}
mapper.select: WITH w AS ( SELECT (date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '7 days')::date AS last_start, (date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '14 days')::date AS prev_start, date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date AS this_start ), t AS ( SELECT m.USER_ID, m.CATEGORY, m.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT AS amt, (m.TRANS_DATE >= w.last_start) AS is_last FROM MYTRANS m, w WHERE m.TYPE = 'OUT' AND COALESCE(m.EXCLUDE_ANALYSIS, 'N') = 'N' AND m.TRANS_DATE >= w.prev_start AND m.TRANS_DATE < w.this_start ), sums AS ( SELECT USER_ID, COALESCE(SUM(amt) FILTER (WHERE is_last), 0) AS last_week, COALESCE(SUM(amt) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_last), 0) AS prev_week, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_last) AS tx_count FROM t GROUP BY USER_ID ), cat AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (USER_ID) USER_ID, CATEGORY, SUM(amt) AS cat_amt FROM t WHERE is_last GROUP BY USER_ID, CATEGORY ORDER BY USER_ID, SUM(amt) DESC ) SELECT s.USER_ID AS userId, s.last_week AS lastWeek, s.prev_week AS prevWeek, s.tx_count AS txCount, c.CATEGORY AS topCategory, COALESCE(c.cat_amt, 0) AS topCategoryAmount, to_char(w.last_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS weekStart FROM sums s JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND u.STATUS = 'Y' LEFT JOIN cat c ON c.USER_ID = s.USER_ID CROSS JOIN w WHERE s.tx_count > 0
